theorem_contract.input: a repeated hyperoctahedral branch, one bounded-support ambient permutation, and sparse Young-seminormal generator actions
theorem_contract.output: the exact b-by-b copy matrix of its K-conjugation orbit average
theorem_contract.non_claim: No polynomial compression of typical ambient Specht spaces, coherent isotypic transform, normalized gap theorem, decoder, or speedup.

theorem.direct_root_fiber_projection: Commuting pair-flip and YJM spectral projectors isolate one signed tableau fiber of exact dimension b(lambda;alpha,beta).
theorem.tableau_propagation: Young-seminormal adjacent-edge recurrences propagate the root fiber through every V_alpha tensor V_beta tableau with a common copy gauge.
theorem.carrier_partial_trace: Averaging the representative contraction over propagated tableaux and equal-weight sign characters equals the copy matrix of the full K twirl.
theorem.width_reduction: The maximum live column width is b rather than b dim(W_mu), while the ambient Specht dimension remains exponential on typical partitions.

proof_obligations.resolution: Use the fiber-width reduction on the ranked multiplicity-26 block and search support cutoffs four through six.
Derive a symbolic occupancy, partition-algebra, or tensor-network contraction before claiming polynomial typical-block access.
Generation alone is insufficient; exact or certified spectra of succinct separator combinations are required.

adversarial_audit.challenge: A single tableau fiber loses the carrier trace.
adversarial_audit.response: Seminormal propagation reconstructs an aligned orthonormal carrier basis, and the result matches a full K_4 twirl.

adversarial_audit.challenge: Signed beta sectors invalidate tableau propagation.
adversarial_audit.response: Independent S_|alpha| and S_|beta| recurrences plus sign-character transport match the separate commutant-projection implementation.

adversarial_audit.challenge: Column-width reduction makes the method polynomial.
adversarial_audit.response: Every fiber still has one row per ambient standard tableau, which is exponential for natural typical partitions.

claim_gate.reason: The exact classical contraction removes carrier column width but not the exponential ambient Specht basis, and it supplies no coherent transform, typical gap theorem, or decoder.

summary: Validated direct signed-YJM multiplicity fibers and carrier partial traces against a full K_4 twirl and an independent S_14 commutant projection.
